انعتلن (form VII)
# اِنْعَتَلْنَ (inʕatalna) /in.ʕa.tal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
# اِنْعَتِلْنَ (inʕatilna) /in.ʕa.til.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْعَتَلَ (inʕatala)
